title: Amazing customer Service
text:
Amazing customer Service. Two black rubber grommets were missing for the front "feet". We mentioned that in a past review and vendor contacted us a promised to send the replacement grommets. a subsequent communication from vendor claimed that they did not have any replacement grommets but that they would send us another product. Well, today we just received two new units. Wow! GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE - way beyond what was necessary.
BTW the drying rack is great. Love the combo flat section and dish rack section. Also very well made and good design.
